name: pdfcn
description: pdfcn brings the shadcn aesthetic to PDFs: a set of components built on top of Takumi and Forme that render documents as clean, composable React elements. It is 100% free, zero-config, and part of the official shadcn-labs ecosystem. For teams already living in the shadcn world, it extends the same component mental model to generated documents.
highlights: Official shadcn-labs extension from UI to PDF
Built on Takumi and Forme rendering engines
curatorNote: The shadcn ecosystem conquered UI; PDFs were the last holdout of ugly templates. Extending the same component philosophy to documents is a small idea with a very wide audience.
